extraction_notes: Scanned PDF with no text layer: every value was transcribed by eye from page images rendered with pdftoppm at 110 dpi (no OCR available). Data-year ambiguity: the title says '2025 Consumer Confidence Report' (report date February 6, 2026, State template revised January 2026, sample dates in 2025) but the 'About This Report' sentence says 'January 1 to December 31, 2024' - treated as a template leftover, data_year 2025. Units were written in the Range columns rather than in the constituent names. Table 6 (unregulated) is empty; Table 7 and Table 9 violations read 'None'; Tables 10-11 (surface water) and the pages 8-10 assessment language are unfilled template text.
